title: UI/使用性テスト v2 — 絶対移動量・直接到達・削除再読込
basis: User explicitly rejected the v1 vertical traversal result as unusable.
v1 measured approximately 26,489px down and 26,601px return travel on 390x844 mobile for the 196-item workload.
Current renderItems expands the full corpus including body text and has no search/filter/paging controls.
Delete/reload diagnosis showed GitHub Contents API can be fresh while browser UI reuses a stale GitHub GET response; a cache:no-store GET candidate eliminated the stale restore in run 34658311864.

target.execution: Playwright Chromium against PR candidate first and published Pages after deploy, with an isolated temporary Git data branch

principles: These v2 criteria are frozen before the UI repair is implemented and are not relaxed after observing results.
A large corpus must not require traversal through preceding items to reach a known item.
Absolute vertical travel is an acceptance criterion; low direction-reversal counts alone are insufficient.
Storage truth and visible UI truth must converge after save, reload, and delete.
Approval/completion state must not be inferred or modified by the usability test.

requiredUiChanges.itemSearch: Search by item ID or title.
requiredUiChanges.kindFilter: Filter by item kind without page navigation.
requiredUiChanges.statusFilter: Filter by item status without page navigation.
requiredUiChanges.compactRows: Do not render item body text expanded by default; keep edit/delete available per row.
requiredUiChanges.boundedPage: Render at most 20 item rows at once and provide previous/next paging when needed.
requiredUiChanges.stickyWorkspaceControls: Primary project actions and project tabs remain reachable without scrolling back through the item corpus.
requiredUiChanges.freshGitHubReads: GitHub GET reads used for live workspace state bypass browser response reuse so reload reflects current repository state.

scenarios.name: 196-item default item view is bounded
pass: visible item rows <= 20
no item body text is expanded by default
mobile item-page document height <= 4 viewport heights
desktop item-page document height <= 3 viewport heights
no horizontal overflow

scenarios.name: Known item direct lookup
pass: TASK-090 is the only matching row for exact ID search
CHECK-34 is the only matching row for exact ID search
neither lookup scrolls through predecessor rows
mobile cumulative vertical travel for each lookup objective <= 2532px
desktop cumulative vertical travel for each lookup objective <= 2000px

scenarios.name: Kind/status filtering and paging
pass: kind filter result count is correct
status filter result count is correct
visible rows remain <= 20
next/previous page changes only the item slice and does not navigate the document
filter or query change returns to page 1

scenarios.name: Primary controls remain reachable
actions: invoke project save or switch project tab
pass: primary project actions and project tabs remain visible/reachable while item rows are scrolled
return travel required to reach a primary project action <= one viewport height
sticky controls do not obscure the active item row or modal trigger

scenarios.name: Delete and reload storage/UI convergence
pass: after first delete GitHub project count is exactly 1 and visible project count is exactly 1
after final delete GitHub project count is exactly 0 and visible project count is exactly 0
deleted projects do not reappear for 5 seconds after final reload
GitHub GET requests used for current workspace reads use an explicit fresh-read policy

scenarios.name: Navigation and operation efficiency
pass: unintended full-document navigation = 0
same-purpose consecutive duplicate clicks = 0
no down-up-down or up-down-up scrolling oscillation for one objective
no objective requires full-corpus vertical traversal

scenarios.name: Mobile and desktop interaction quality
pass: primary interactive touch targets are at least 44x44 CSS px on mobile
fixed/sticky overlays do not cover the center point of active controls
search/filter/pager remain usable at both viewports

scenarios.name: Runtime quality and regression
pass: unhandled page errors = 0
unexpected API 4xx/5xx = 0
unexpected console errors = 0
Stage B, C-01, C-02, and C-03 regression workflows remain PASS

resultRule: All UI2-01 through UI2-08 must PASS. The historical v1 SUCCESS cannot override the user's explicit vertical-usability FAIL.
